name: V sredu skorbnoye ditya...
source:
A short, gloomy story that brings a new character straight from The Addams Family into the cozy world of the pioneer camp. Wednesday: a pale, emotionless, oppressive girl who will bring with her not only a new perspective on the realities of the Everlasting Summer world, but also a new season previously alien to the summer camp - autumn. Welcome to Sovyonok, Wednesday! 

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3034936048]Steam[/url]]
